ResStock Measure Documentation: Advanced Air Sealing With Drill-and-Fill Wall Insulation

item.text:
In **ResStock 2025 Release 1**, the Advanced Air Sealing upgrade:

- **Eligibility:** Dwelling units with baseline air leakage **≥6 ACH50**; units below 6 ACH50 are excluded.
- **Target:** Eligible homes are sealed to **5 ACH50**—five air changes per hour at a pressure difference of 50 pascals.
- **Coverage:** About **92% of existing dwelling units** in the modeled stock.

Source: [ResStock measure documentation, pp. 1 and 5](https://docs.nlr.gov/docs/fy26osti/96281.pdf).
